title: 突厥卢布
concept: On one plain dark tabletop, two separate FLAT stacks of paper currency seen from slightly above: left stack old, ornate, dark ocher banknote border motifs; right stack newer, simpler, consistent ivory banknote motifs. A conspicuous empty gap separates them. No coin, map, camel, cotton, words or numerals. Palette only old ocher and ivory.
prompt: Create ONE finished Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon. Use the attached image only as a stylistic reference for the outer engraved gold laurel wreath, small red star and blank gold ribbon; create an entirely new central scene. On one plain dark tabletop, two separate FLAT stacks of paper currency seen from slightly above: left stack old, ornate, dark ocher banknote border motifs; right stack newer, simpler, consistent ivory banknote motifs. Exactly one centered emblem in square canvas. TRUE RGBA transparent background outside wreath and ribbon, alpha 0 all four corners, broad transparent exterior (20–50 percent total pixels).
